intro: This ritualistic step marks the culmination of the shaman's ordeal at the Brazier of Everfount along the coast of Silverpine Forest. Having shattered the corrupt spirits threatening the spring with a burst of elemental radiance, the shaman stands before an apparition of pure water to receive its communion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
